headline: Malawi opens state gold trading center in Karonga to curb illegal mining
summary: Mining Minister Thoko Tembo inaugurated a formal gold trading facility in Karonga, marking the country’s sixth state-run hub aimed at integrating artisanal gold miners into the formal economy and curbing illicit trade.
why: Formalizing artisanal precious metal extraction strengthens national foreign exchange reserves and fiscal revenue collections in developing economies.
